DialogNodeSpec.description: One line of a conversation. NPC and PC lines alternate: the children of an NPC line are PC lines and the reverse.

condition.description: Script that decides whether this line is shown.

end.description: NPC line that deliberately ends the conversation (a fight starts). Normally omit: answers return to the main menu.

quest.description: Journal tag to advance when this line plays (with `questEntry`).

questEntry.description: Journal entry id to set for `quest`.

script.description: Script run when this line plays (resref of an existing script).

nodes.description: Root lines. Each must be an NPC line; the first is the greeting whose PC children are the main menu.

resref.description: Dialog resref: lower-case letters, digits and underscore, at most 16 characters.

returnToHub.description: Default true: every answer returns to the main menu and a leave option is added.
